text:
Sam (People Ops): Marta's start is Mon. Quick snag: the name on her passport is 'Marta Alvarez-Gomez' but the offer and payroll have 'Marta Gomez' (no hyphen). Shes arriving Sat night and asked if we can do I-9 on Sun (weekend). Also staying in an Airbnb — concerns about hotel delivery.

Iris (Recruiter): Marta can make a Sunday slot if we can do it. She has a provisional CA DL that lists 'Marta Gomez' and says she can get an SSA letter (name discrepancy) but not until Tue. Shes worried payroll will stall.

Lina (Onboarding): For I-9 we need original documents. Passport is fine even with different formatting of last name as long as it proves identity AND matches immigration status. The offer name mismatch is a payroll/legal name question — payroll can accept but needs a notarized name-affidavit if SSA letter isn't ready. For weekend: we can do an in-person I-9 on Sun 11am if someone can meet, or remote NotaryNow session (candidate must be physically in the US).

BGCheck Team: Background vendor note: name variations sometimes flag fuzzy-matching; without SSN we can still run checks but we may get manual review requests. If she signs consent now and provides the passport + provisional DL now, we can start ID checks. SSA letter can be uploaded when available; add note in vendor ticket.

Marta (new hire): I can do Sunday 11am. Airbnb hosts don't accept business packages; prefer FedEx Hold For Pickup at the nearest kiosk. I can pick up after my flight. I can also do NotaryNow on Sunday evening if needed. Also request Spanish interpreter for Day 1 and live-captioning for orientation videos (accessibility).

IT-bot: Shipping to FedEx Hold-for Pickup OK. Use this label format and include Marta mobile. Asset held until AUP signed.

```
Hold for: Marta Gomez / Redwood Inference
FedEx Location: 385 Market St SF Kiosk
Recipient name: Marta Gomez
Mobile: +1 415-555-0999
```

IT-bot: Note: if we hold at FedEx, provisioning can be queued and asset pickup will trigger AUP link re-check. VPN/profile staged but inactive until AUP ack.

NotaryNow-bot: Remote sessions available 8am-10pm PST. Reminder: remote notary requires original docs to be shown on camera and candidate physically in the US during session. Schedule: https://notarynow.example/schedule

FedEx-bot: Confirmed: FedEx Hold For Pickup permitted for corporate shipments. Use tracking and hold-for reference in package notes. Kiosk hours 9am-7pm Sun.

Sam (People Ops): Proposed plan: 1) Sunday 11am in-person I-9 at HQ with Spanish interpreter booked, 2) IT to ship laptop to FedEx Hold-for Pickup (Marta picks up), 3) Marta to upload passport + provisional DL + sign BG consent now, 4) If Marta can't make HQ, fallback to NotaryNow Sunday evening. Lina will add note to payroll about the name variation and affidavit path.

Marta (new hire): Uploading passport + provisional DL and BG consent now. Thanks for arranging Spanish interpreter and live-captioning 603

Lina (Onboarding): Spanish interpreter confirmed for Sunday 11am. Calendar invite created with NotaryNow fallback link and checklist: upload passport (photo), upload provisional DL, sign BG consent, sign AUP prior to pickup. Ill also flag payroll for name-affidavit workflow in case SSA letter arrives late.

BGCheck Team: Received consent and documents. Starting ID verification now; marking SSN pending. Will comment in vendor ticket about name variance to reduce false positives.

Sam (People Ops): IT will queue laptop to FedEx today. Marta, once you pick up and sign AUP, ping here and we'll finalize payroll provisioning. Thanks team :thumbsup:
